about_short_description.short_description: Kavak is a digital platform transforming the way people buy, sell, finance, and service cars.

product.name: Used Car Buying Platform
product.description: An online platform for browsing, selecting, and purchasing pre-owned cars with options for financing and delivery.

product.name: Used Car Selling Service
product.description: A service enabling car owners to sell their used vehicles by receiving instant price offers and scheduling inspections.

product.name: Vehicle Inspection and Certification
product.description: A process involving expert mechanical inspections to certify the condition and quality of used cars before sale.

product.name: Used Car Financing
product.description: Financing options for purchasing used cars, offering fixed installment plans and online loan management.

product.name: After-Sales Services and Support
product.description: Post-purchase services including customer support, vehicle maintenance guidance, and assistance with paperwork.
